query: select jsonb_build_object('policies',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) from pg_policies p where schemaname in ('public','finance_private')),'triggers',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('relation',c.oid::regclass::text,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid))) from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname in ('public','finance_private') and not t.tgisinternal),'constraints',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('relation',c.oid::regclass::text,'name',k.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid))) from pg_constraint k join pg_class c on c.oid=k.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public'),'views',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.oid::regclass::text,'options',c.reloptions,'definition',pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true))) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('v','m')),'indexes',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)) from pg_indexes i where schemaname='public')) metadata;

((sender_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM orders o
  WHERE ((o.id = order_chat.order_id) AND (o.driver_id IS NOT NULL) AND (o.status = ANY (ARRAY['preparing'::order_status, 'ready'::order_status, 'pickedup'::order_status])) AND ((o.customer_id = auth.uid()) OR (o.driver_id = auth.uid()))))))

policies.qual:
(is_admin() OR has_perm('orders'::text) OR has_perm('support'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM orders o
  WHERE ((o.id = order_recipient.order_id) AND ((o.customer_id = auth.uid()) OR (o.driver_id = auth.uid()))))))

(has_perm('support'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM support_tickets t
  WHERE ((t.id = ticket_messages.ticket_id) AND (t.customer_id = auth.uid())))))

((available AND approved AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM stores s
  WHERE ((s.id = menu_items.store_id) AND s.is_active)))) OR owns_store(store_id) OR has_perm('stores'::text))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM menu_items m
  WHERE ((m.id = item_option_groups.item_id) AND (owns_store(m.store_id) OR has_perm('stores'::text)))))
